Day 1 • Outdoor Exploration

Ku-ring-gai Wildflowers, Village Café & Playground

🌿 Nature & Energy Day
9:30 AM - 12:00 PM

Ku-ring-gai Wildflower Garden Bushwalk

Start our four-day adventure exploring the tranquil native Australian bushland in St Ives! We'll walk along shaded paths, discover vibrant native blossoms like Banksias and Waratahs, and spot wild kookaburras, lizards, and butterflies.

📍 420 Mona Vale Rd, St Ives 🎟️ Free entry (Council park)
🌐 Visit Official Website
Fun Rating:
12:30 PM - 1:45 PM

Relaxed Lunch in Wahroonga Village

Head into charming Wahroonga Village for a cozy sit-down lunch at a friendly café. The girls get fluffy marshmallow babycinos, warm toasted sandwiches, and fresh fruit bowls while Dad gets his espresso refuel!

📍 Railway Ave & Coonanbarra Rd, Wahroonga ☕ Treat: Babycinos with extra sprinkles
🍽️ Local Village Cafés
Fun Rating:
2:00 PM - 4:00 PM

Bannockburn Oval Playground Energy Burn

Time to sprint, climb, and swing! The girls can tackle the climbing net, fly on the swings, zoom down the slides, and kick a ball across the green oval. Perfect for running off all that afternoon energy.

📍 Bannockburn Rd, Pymble 🎪 Features: Modern climbing play tower & swings
🌐 Visit Council Page
Fun Rating:

FRI
Day 2 • Big City & Maritime Wonders

Darling Harbour: Sea Life Aquarium & Maritime Museum

🚆 Train Adventure into the City
10:00 AM - 1:00 PM

SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium Exploration

Journey deep into the ocean zone! Walk through the iconic glass shark tunnels where giant grey nurse sharks, graceful stingrays, and rescued sea turtles glide right over your heads. Say hello to Pig the dugong and the colony of sub-Antarctic penguins!

📍 1-5 Wheat Rd, Darling Harbour 💡 Tip: Pre-booked online tickets skip queues
🌐 Visit Aquarium Homepage
Fun Rating:
2:00 PM - 4:30 PM

Australian National Maritime Museum (Submarine & Tall Ships)

Strap on your sailor hats! We are boarding genuine historic vessels at the wharf. Climb inside the Cold War submarine HMAS Onslow to look through the periscope, and explore the tall ship James Craig and destroyer HMAS Vampire.

📍 2 Murray St, Darling Harbour ⚓ Highlights: Submarine hatch & Captain's wheel
🌐 Visit Museum Homepage
Fun Rating:
🤫

SAT
Day 3 • Sydney Harbour Ferry & Wildlife

Taronga Zoo Sydney Safari, Bird Show & Ferry Cruise

⛴️ Circular Quay Ferry Crossing
9:15 AM - 10:00 AM

Circular Quay to Taronga Zoo Ferry Cruise

Hop aboard Sydney's iconic green and yellow ferry at Circular Quay! Feel the sea breeze, watch the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge glide past, and snap awesome twin selfies on the top deck before docking at the zoo wharf.

📍 Wharf 4, Circular Quay 📸 Highlight: Best harbour skyline photo spot
⛴️ Sydney Ferries (Opal/Card)
Fun Rating:
10:00 AM - 4:00 PM

Taronga Zoo: Giraffe Feeding & Free-Flight Bird Show

A full day of animal wonders! Catch the world-famous Free-Flight Bird Show overlooking the harbour, get up close with tall giraffes at the African Savannah, visit sleepy koalas along the Australian walk, and watch playful Asian elephants splashing.

📍 Bradleys Head Rd, Mosman 🦒 Don't miss: 12:00 PM & 3:00 PM Bird Show
🌐 Visit Taronga Zoo Homepage
Fun Rating:
🤫

SUN
Day 4 • National Park Picnic & Retro Gaming

Bobbin Head Waterside Picnic & Dad's Retro Arcade Night

🏎️ Mercedes Drive & Arcade Battles
10:00 AM - 10:45 AM

Scenic Mercedes Cruise through Ku-ring-gai Chase

Windows cracked, the girls' favorite road trip playlist playing on the Mercedes sound system, rolling down through the eucalyptus forests into the peaceful marina basin at Bobbin Head.

🚗 Cruise route: Ku-ring-gai Chase Rd 🎵 Daughters' DJ privilege in the car!
🎵 Dad's Road Trip Beats
Fun Rating:
11:00 AM - 2:00 PM

Bobbin Head Waterside Picnic & Mangrove Boardwalk

Unpack the big picnic blanket right by Cowan Water! Enjoy delicious snacks, watch the luxury boats bobbing at Empire Marina, stroll across the Mangrove Boardwalk to spot scurrying crabs, and play lawn games in the park.

📍 Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park, Bobbin Head 🧺 Menu: Sandwiches, fruit kebabs & treats
🌐 Visit Bobbin Head Page
Fun Rating:
3:30 PM - Evening

The Grand Retro Video Game Championship at Home

Fire up the retro console! Classic kart racing, cooperative 2D platformers, and vintage arcade matches. Dad thinks he has old-school skills, but Avery and Lily are teaming up to take the trophy! Complete with popcorn, DIY pizza, and victory dances.

🎮 Featured: Classic Mario Kart, Retro Platformers & Arcade Battles 🏆 Grand Prize: Twin Trophy & bragging rights!
🕹️ Living Room Arcade
